decision_conditions: The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The front drive and parking area hereby permitted shall not be brought into use until the proposed scheme of hard and soft landscape works shown on plan reference SD2403P05D for the forecourt of the site is fully implemented, including the front boundary wall and adjacent planting area, and retained thereafter.&nbsp;
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:<br></p><p>Site Location Plan; SD2403(P)01 – Existing Ground and Roof Plans; SD2403(P)02 – Existing Elevations; SD2403(P)03-C – Proposed Ground and Roof Plans; SD2403(P)04-E – Proposed Elevations (received 19.08.24); SD2403(P)05-D - Proposed Elevations [Existing &amp; Proposed Forecourt Plans] (received 07.08.24); Heritage Statement; Fire Safety – Reasonable Exemption Statement</p><p>All plans received 16.07.24 unless otherwise stated</p><div><br></div>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The new hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall be constructed from porous materials, for example, permeable block paving, gravel or porous asphalt,&nbsp; Please note: guidance on permeable paving has now been published by the Environment Agency on http://www.communities.gov.uk/publications/planningandbuilding/pavingfrontgardens.<br></p><div><br></div>
The materials to be used in the construction of the front boundary wall hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing or adjacent walls (unless otherwise agreed in writing).&nbsp;
description: Replacement 0.85m high front boundary wall; hardstanding and landscaping to front garden; steps to front entrance; single storey rear extension (retrospective); rear patio extension; alteration and replacement of garage door; roof lights in rear and side roof slopes; replacement windows with double glazed windows (Demolition of conservatory) [AMENDED SCHEME]
